messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Employment, Leisure, tourism and sport, Reproductive health, Specific diseases, disorders and medical conditions, Family life and marriage, and Gender and gender roles in German Democratic Republic (1949-1990) during the 1980s, matching this research need: Survey data on women’s health, menstruation, contraception, fertility, sexuality, partnership quality, domestic labor, childrearing, work conditions, housing, and work-family balance, including partner relations, violence, and financial arrangements.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
